principle: Byte identity is strong provenance evidence, not a universal scientific-validity requirement. Prospective Paper V1 validity depends on shared pre-frozen authority, PIT/availability semantics, formulation/evaluator semantics, and bounded material differences.

scope_separation.historical_claim_reproduction: Prefer and report exact historical artifact hashes when available. A byte mismatch prevents claiming exact reproduction of that historical artifact, but does not by itself invalidate a new prospective experiment.
scope_separation.prospective_paper_v1: All matched arms must use the same pre-frozen authority snapshot and evaluator semantics. Exact equality to V0/E1 historical parquet bytes is not required if the parity gate below passes before prospective outcomes are observed.

GREEN.meaning: scientifically equivalent for the intended experiment; no launch block
conditions_any: same semantic contracts and exact coordinate/NaN masks with numeric differences within GREEN numeric tolerance

numeric_tolerance.rule: pass when abs_diff <= absolute OR relative_diff <= relative for finite overlapping values

AMBER.meaning: minor implementation/data-revision drift; does not automatically block a prospective matched experiment, but requires a provenance note and all arms must use the same frozen snapshot
requirements: no PIT or available-time semantic change
differences are frozen before prospective outcomes

triggers: Q0/OOS or future outcome read used to construct/search/select the authority
feature semantic formula change hidden as numeric parity
mapping, accounting, court, cost or eligibility semantic drift
coordinate or missingness drift above AMBER limits without a predeclared scientific reason
numeric drift above AMBER tolerance on materially used features

required_for: proving exact historical reproduction when that claim is made
not_required_for: declaring two independently serialized numeric sidecars scientifically equivalent under this policy
admitting a new prospective common data snapshot that is frozen before outcomes

known_pre_pilot_example.note: NaN masks matched and the difference is far below the frozen GREEN tolerance; it is not a scientific failure.
